verdict.rationale: cubic finds bugs in PRs and across the codebase, offers codebase-aware chat for asking about code, generates fixes, and can auto-resolve findings once an issue is fixed, which loosely covers locating and verifying fixes. Nothing shows it reproducing issues or doing runtime root-cause debugging; its approach is static AI review. Missing for 10: issue reproduction (running or replaying failures), explicit root-cause narrowing workflows, execution-based verification of fixes beyond thread auto-resolution, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Codebase scans deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities across your repository.
Select code and choose **Add to AI chat** to ask about it with the diff and codebase as context.
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
